appointment_policy: Appointments can be booked 1-30 days in advance. Same-day appointments are subject to doctor availability.
cancellation_policy: Appointments must be cancelled at least 4 hours in advance to avoid a cancellation fee.
prescription_policy: Prescription refills require a valid prescription ID and are processed within 24 hours.
emergency_note: For medical emergencies, please call 911 or visit your nearest emergency room immediately.
privacy_note: Your medical information is protected under HIPAA. We never share patient data without consent.
